project: Sewer and stormwater stack replacement, roof drainage upgrade, and podium pump-out renewal for an 8-storey multi-residential building
scope_of_works: Remove and replace deteriorated sanitary and stormwater pipework in risers, ceilings and plant areas; complete staged service isolations; upgrade roof drainage points and downpipes; replace pump-out components; reinstate penetrations and finishes; pressure test, commission, and return services to occupants in stages.
